paper_title: Search for axion-like particles through nuclear Primakoff production using the GlueX detector
notes: ALP-photon coupling search via nuclear Primakoff production at GlueX. The exclusion is on 1/Lambda (GeV^-1) from the interaction L = (1/4Lambda) a F F~, equivalent to g_agamma. Mass range 200-450 MeV (2e8-4.5e8 eV). Limits at O(1 TeV) scale, i.e. 1/Lambda ~ 1e-3 GeV^-1, with most stringent apparent limit ~1e-3 at 360 MeV. Data points are approximate, read from Fig. 7/8 (observed 95% CL). Fixed-target/collider-style bound, so no DM density.
